verdict.rationale: The UK Intellectual Property Office is a government IP registry and filing service, so user-authored automations that can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back are a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation-building feature that would make the axis apply. The documented features are trade mark and patent filing, searching, tracking, renewal and email alerts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
